cases.question: I joined on April 18 as an eligible full-time employee. On what date does my health, dental and vision coverage begin?

forbidden_assertions: Coverage begins April 18.

cases.question: For a lost laptop report, which details should I send IT Support and how quickly must I report it?

required_facts.source_quote: Employees must report lost or stolen devices to IT Support within 2 hours of discovery.

required_facts.text: The report should include the device type, last known location, whether customer data may have been accessed, and whether the device was company-managed or personal.
required_facts.source_quote: The report should include the device type, last known location, whether customer data may have been accessed, and whether the device was company-managed or personal.

forbidden_assertions: Lost devices may be reported at the end of the week.

cases.question: A USD 42 taxi expense has no merchant receipt. What information belongs in my signed missing-receipt attestation?

required_facts.source_quote: Missing receipts require a signed missing-receipt attestation that explains the business purpose, amount, date, and merchant.

cases.question: When replacing a monitor, which reasons for the request does Operations ask me to identify?

required_facts.source_quote: Replacement equipment requires the employee to state whether the request is due to breakage, loss, upgrade, or accessibility need.

cases.question: For a database migration, list the required review materials and the approver in our deployment handbook.

required_facts.source_quote: | Database migration | Peer review, rollback plan, staging proof | Engineering Manager |

cases.question: For a Growth-tier support case with enough identifiers supplied, what are the initial response, status update and target resolution timings?
cases.rationale: Reads three requested columns preserving business units and target status.

required_facts.source_quote: | Growth | 4 business hours | Every business day | 5 business days |

forbidden_assertions: Growth resolution is guaranteed within 5 calendar days.

cases.question: What must a promotion recommendation demonstrate beyond time served?
cases.rationale: Requests promotion criteria and tenure qualification.

required_facts.text: Promotion recommendations require sustained performance at the next level, evidence of scope expansion, peer impact, and business outcomes.
required_facts.source_quote: Promotion recommendations require sustained performance at the next level, evidence of scope expansion, peer impact, and business outcomes.

required_facts.text: A promotion should not be based on tenure alone.
required_facts.source_quote: A promotion should not be based on tenure alone.

forbidden_assertions: Tenure alone qualifies an employee for promotion.

cases.question: How far ahead should a seven-business-day vacation request be submitted?

required_facts.text: A seven-business-day vacation request should be submitted at least 20 business days in advance.
required_facts.source_quote: Requests longer than 5 business days should be submitted at least 20 business days in advance.

forbidden_assertions: A seven-business-day vacation request only needs 10 business days of advance notice.

cases.question: I have an approved remote arrangement. For my home workspace, what devices/tools may access confidential information, and what network and screen precautions are my responsibility?
cases.rationale: Combines approved devices/tools with separate network and screen precautions.

required_facts.text: Confidential information may only be accessed on approved devices using company-approved tools.
required_facts.source_quote: Confidential and restricted data may only be accessed on approved devices using company-approved tools.

required_facts.text: Employees working remotely are responsible for using secure networks, avoiding shared public computers, and protecting screens from unauthorized viewing.
required_facts.source_quote: Employees working remotely are responsible for using secure networks, avoiding shared public computers, and protecting screens from unauthorized viewing.

cases.question: For an approved role-related course, what is my annual learning allowance in CAD, and if the resulting expense is approved and submitted six business days before payroll close, when is it reimbursed?
cases.rationale: Requests a CAD amount and concrete timing outcome from two policies, not adjacent fields or USD amounts.

required_facts.text: The annual allowance for approved role-related courses is 1,500 CAD.
required_facts.source_quote: Employees receive an annual learning budget of 1,500 CAD or 1,100 USD for approved courses, books, conferences, and certifications related to their role.

required_facts.text: The approved report submitted six business days before payroll close is reimbursed in the next regular payroll cycle.
required_facts.source_quote: Approved expense reports are reimbursed in the next regular payroll cycle when submitted at least five business days before payroll close.

cases.question: We are onboarding a vendor that will process company data. Before it receives data, which Operations reviews must finish, and what security review timing does Finance require relative to signature?
cases.rationale: Combines Operations reviewers and data gate with Finance signature timing.

required_facts.text: A vendor processing company data requires Operations, Legal, and IT Admin review.
required_facts.source_quote: | High | Vendor processing company or customer data | Operations, Legal, IT Admin |

required_facts.text: The vendor may not receive company data until required reviews are complete.
required_facts.source_quote: Vendors may not receive company data, customer data, credentials, or building access until required reviews are complete.

required_facts.text: Vendors that will process company data must complete the vendor security review before contract signature, even when the spend is below USD 10,000.
required_facts.source_quote: Vendors that will process company data must complete the vendor security review before contract signature, even when the spend is below USD 10,000.

cases.question: A prospect asks for an unusual confidentiality period in its NDA and a custom integration. Who needs to review the NDA, and whom should I consult to confirm exact integration support?

required_facts.text: The NDA with an unusual confidentiality period requires Legal review before signature.
required_facts.source_quote: Non-standard NDAs, unilateral NDAs, and NDAs with unusual confidentiality periods require Legal review before signature.

required_facts.text: Sales Representatives should confirm exact integration support with Solutions Engineering.
required_facts.source_quote: Sales Representatives should confirm exact integration support with Solutions Engineering.

What approval is needed before I communicate the credit, which incident wording is approved, and what review must an AI-generated customer draft receive?
cases.rationale: Support supplies approval and wording; Acceptable Use supplies required review of an AI customer draft.

required_facts.text: The credit must be approved by a Manager before it is communicated.
required_facts.source_quote: The credit must be approved by a Manager before it is communicated.

required_facts.text: Approved wording for unresolved incidents: "We are investigating the issue and will share the next update by the stated support cadence."

required_facts.text: Any generated AI draft of that customer communication must be reviewed before being sent.
required_facts.source_quote: Generated AI output must be reviewed before being sent to customers, used for policy interpretation, or relied on for security decisions.

cases.question: As a manager preparing a new hire, when should onboarding finish, who assigns the buddy, and how frequently should our ongoing one-on-ones occur?
cases.rationale: Combines onboarding with Manager-only ongoing meeting cadence; unasked check-in timing is excluded.

cases.question: I am planning a business trip that is absent from the department plan. What travel approval is needed before booking, and what is the standard daily USD limit for meals during business travel?

required_facts.source_quote: Managers approve travel before booking when the trip is not already listed in the department plan.

required_facts.source_quote: | Meals during business travel | USD 85 per day | Manager approval above limit |

cases.rationale: Engineering supplies the target; the IT-only guide supplies record fields.

required_facts.source_quote: For price objections, Sales Representatives should connect value to reduced reporting effort, faster approvals, fewer data quality escalations, and better executive visibility.

cases.question: In our manager handbook, what should one-on-one notes focus on and what personal detail restriction applies?

cases.question: In the engineering handbook, what qualifies a Friday production deployment?

cases.question: Can I share this with them?

cases.question: Is the usual deadline still in effect?
cases.rationale: There is no identified policy, event, deadline, or prior context.
